RNA-binding proteins (3 of them): ⇒ Work with Ananya for this

PPRC1, PGC1a, PGC1b (RRMs) 

RBP-plate clones

Christian Dienemann (RREB1) → NCAP-SELEX or modified NCAP-SELEX

*Protein Plate Preparation (NCAP-SELEX \+ HT-SELEX → Round 3\)*

Quadrant 1 \+ Quadrant 4

Quadrant 2 \+ Quadrant 3

We need at least 100 uL of diluted protein for the total run (4.5 per well X 4 cycles X (1HT \+ 1NCAP) X 2 ligands)

Take 30 uL of protein per well and then add 180 uL TF dilution buffer per well. Distribute 80 uL per well an Abgene Storage plate 384-well.

Recombinant commercial ELF2 ⇒ For approx. 25 ng/uL protein ⇒ 9.5 uL protein solution (Make this up to 50 uL with TF dilution buffer just before actual dilution)

*Cultures to set up for induction*

A6-A9
